name: KORA
cover:
Seoul subway:
which side
do you board?

features.label: The usual way
features.headline:
Two platforms.
Which one?
features.text:
Reading the map is the easy part.
On the platform, you freeze.

features.label: Read the sign
features.headline:
Toward
Seoul Station
features.text:
KORA names the direction exactly
as the train's sign shows it.

features.label: Double check
features.headline:
Next stop
confirms it
features.text:
See the next station in Korean and English,
or point the camera at the platform sign.

features.label: Bonus
features.headline:
A buzz before
your stop
features.text:
It counts the stops while you ride
and tells you when to get ready.

outro:
Board the right
train the first time
